messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis population mean 98.6. They ask: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" That seems like they want to compute the p-value? Or maybe compute the test statistic? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might be "standard error"? Actually "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation of the sampling distribution under the null hypothesis" which is the standard error: sigma/sqrt(n). But they gave sample standard deviation, not population. So we can approximate standard error as s/sqrt(n) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Then compute t-statistic: (98.2 - 98.6) / (s/sqrt(n)). Then compute p-value. The tool function calculates p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. We can call it. Provide sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. two_tailed default true. Then get p-value. Let's do that.
